[[File:Steel arrow(p) detail.png|left|120px]] |version3 = [[File:Steel arrow(p) detail.png|left|120px]] |version4 = [[File:Steel arrow(p) detail.png|left|120px]] }} '''Steel arrows''' are stronger than [[iron arrow]]s, and can be used with any standard [[bow]] of [[Oak bow|oak]] or stronger. Steel arrows can be made at level 30 Fletching by using 15 [[steel arrowtips]] on 15 [[headless arrow]]s, granting 75 [[Fletching]] [[experience]]. As with most [[Arrow|arrows]], they can be [[Poison#Weapon poisoning|poisoned]]. [[Ava's accumulator]] (from the [[Animal Magnetism]] quest) generates steel arrows in the [[ammo slot]], and also randomly attracts items into your inventory. Steel arrows can be purchased from [[Lowe's Archery Emporium]] in [[Varrock]], or [[Brian's Archery Supplies]] in [[Rimmington]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |version1 = Unpoisoned |version2 =
